## R Markdown

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gganimate)
library(broom)
library(magick)

# --- Part 1: Basic Reveal Animation ---
ice_data <- read_csv("lake_mendota_ice.csv") %>%
  rename(
    year_range = Category,
    annual_days = `Annual number of days`,
    avg_5yr = `Five-year running average`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = as.numeric(str_sub(year_range, 1, 4))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(annual_days)
```
